title: Kubernetes Security
brief: **Ticket:** audit a Deployment. Find the most dangerous container setting.
theory:
## Kubernetes security
Apply the Pod Security 'restricted' profile: no privileged containers, runAsNonRoot, no privilege escalation, read-only fs, drop capabilities, resource limits, no host namespaces. Enforce with Kyverno/OPA at admission.

knowledge_check.q: Enforcing policy at ___ rejects insecure pods, not just detects them

investigation.intro: Audit the insecure Deployment with the validator.
steps: The tests show the validator flagging the insecure pod (privileged, host-network, run-as-root).
Read manifests/insecure/deployment.yaml - the most dangerous setting is the answer.
hints: It gives the container full host access.

capture.task: **Name the worst setting.** Which container securityContext setting is CRITICAL? (one word)
